June, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul, before his call with Mateo Quiroga. The fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team. That's from the #strategic-pod thread that day, which you can see.

One thing to check: a 30 Sep strategic digest in the knowledge brain also cites #8841, but describes a different problem (Dock Door 14 not selectable on the Newark check-in kiosk, escalated to platform engineering). Either the number was reused or the digest is wrong, so confirm against the ticket system before relying on either.
